actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Build your own Maxio action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized with your Maxio connection.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

input.name: amount
input.label: Amount
input.hint: Enter amount in dollars as such - $10.00 would be filled in as 10.00

input.name: memo
input.label: Memo
input.hint: A helpful explanation of the charge. This amount will remind you and your customer for the reason for the assessment of the charge.

input.name: product_id
input.label: Product ID
input.hint: Either product handle or product ID is required

input.name: customer_id
input.label: Customer ID
input.hint: Either customer ID or customer reference or adding a new customer is required

input.name: newcustomer_first_name
input.label: First name of new customer
input.hint: Required if creating a new customer

input.name: newcustomer_last_name
input.label: Last name of new customer
input.hint: Required if creating a new customer

input.name: newcustomer_email
input.label: Email of new customer
input.hint: Required if creating a new customer

input.name: creditcard_first_name
input.label: First name on credit card
input.hint: If not provided, First name of the customer will be used

input.name: creditcard_last_name
input.label: Last name on credit card
input.hint: If not provided, Last name of the customer will be used
